caption: Two women sit in green armchairs indoors. On the left, a woman with long blonde hair wears a denim jacket over an orange patterned dress, speaking and gesturing actively. On the right, a woman with short, wavy brown hair in a white sleeveless top listens while resting her hand near a small white dog sitting between them. The background features a wooden table with books, a Cafe Society sign, and a large window overlooking a city.

A man in a striped Mickey Mouse tee and short brown hair sits beside a woman with a reddish-brown bob in a green crown-print shirt. They sit at a glass-topped wooden table with noodle bowls. The man glances right and speaks while the woman looks down, holding chopsticks. The indoor setting includes wooden chairs and a traditional window.

Two men sit for an interview against a promotional film backdrop. The man on the left has curly black hair, a full beard, and a medium build, wearing a black button-down shirt. The man on the right is slender with wavy hair and a beard, also in a black shirt. He speaks while gesturing with his hands and briefly adjusts his hair. The background consists of blue and white posters for the movie Valatty, featuring release dates and a character portrait. The setting is a brightly lit press event.

Two slim women sit on a black leather sofa. The woman on the left has long black hair and wears a black tube top, while the woman on the right has short black hair, green nail polish, and a black t-shirt with sunglasses on her head. The woman on the right talks and gestures with her right hand while her companion listens and smiles. The background features a bookshelf and wall posters in a dimly lit indoor room.

A fair-skinned woman in a white dress with black bow details sits next to a man in a black t-shirt. Both have dark hair. The man speaks, looking toward the woman, who glances at him then at the camera. Yellow text appears between them against a plain white studio background.

Two women sit for an interview against purple curtains. The woman on the left has short silver hair and wears a black high-neck dress with beaded cuffs. The woman on the right has straight blonde hair and wears a strapless sequined gown with a red flower pin. Both hold gold microphones and engage in conversation while seated. Two gold Emmy awards are positioned on stands in the foreground within this studio environment.

Two women sit on a tan sofa in a studio. The woman on the left has blonde hair and wears a black blazer with a white flower pin. The woman on the right has dark curly hair, a sleeveless patterned dress, and a heart necklace. She speaks toward the camera, gesturing with her right index finger while holding a blue card. The background consists of beige walls with decorative molding and a broadcast logo in the corner.

Oprah Winfrey, featuring dark curly hair and a black v-neck top with a beaded necklace, speaks enthusiastically to the camera. She displays wide mouth movements and expressive facial gestures throughout the clip. The background shows a blurred studio audience seated in tiered rows.

A man with short dark hair in a black graphic t-shirt sits beside a woman with long blonde hair in a black top. The man speaks toward the camera while the woman listens and smiles. They are seated in an indoor space featuring a city-view window to the left and tan curtains to the right. A movie logo is superimposed at the top of the frame.

Two men sit in wooden director's chairs against a plain white studio background. The man on the left has a muscular build and dark hair, wearing a teal knit vest and dark trousers. He gestures actively with both hands while speaking. The man on the right has curly light-brown hair and wears a beige button-down shirt with matching pants, listening and smiling while holding a glass bottle. Both individuals hold white promotional cards and maintain eye contact during their conversation.

A slender blonde woman with long straight hair wears a navy long-sleeved top and a thick gold chain necklace while speaking into a green-tipped studio microphone. She maintains a focused expression, moving her lips and head slightly as she talks. Behind her sits a studio audience featuring women in pink and black attire. The setting is a brightly lit, neutral indoor studio.

Oprah Winfrey, featuring dark wavy hair and glasses in a pinstripe suit, speaks and gestures with her right hand. Beside her, an older man in a dark suit and red tie listens intently. They sit in a television studio against a blurred nighttime city skyline backdrop. Bloomberg branding and an Up Next graphic are visible.

Two young men stand against a dark, vertical-textured wall during an interview. The man on the left has styled dark hair and wears a light pink corduroy blazer without an undershirt, speaking and gesturing toward the camera. The man on the right wears a tan corduroy suit over a white shirt and silver necklace, looking at his companion with a smile. A pink branded microphone is held in front of them. The scene is brightly lit from the front in an indoor event setting.

Two men sit on a couch before a wall with green leaf patterns. The man on the left wears a white t-shirt and reviews papers, while the man on the right wears a black logo t-shirt and speaks into a branded microphone. A black cat statue sits on a side table to the right. The shot remains static, capturing a simple indoor interview.

A fair-skinned woman with hair in a bun wears a white draped blouse, standing beside a man in a black zip-up jacket. The man speaks into a microphone while the woman remains still. They stand before a dark, textured background featuring media logos.

Marion Cotillard, in a red one-shoulder dress with dark wavy hair, smiles and watches Brad Pitt. Pitt wears a navy blazer and scarf with a light goatee, speaking and gesturing slightly. They are positioned against a solid dark gray studio background.

A woman with wavy brown hair wearing a black polka-dot blouse sits beside a man in a dark blazer and navy shirt. Both individuals have red ribbons pinned to their chests. Against a plain black studio backdrop, the woman listens attentively while the man speaks and makes subtle hand gestures, eventually touching his face. A radio station logo is visible in the upper-left corner.

Two men sit on a yellow sofa in a colorful studio. The man on the left is bald, wearing a grey blazer over a graphic t-shirt. The man on the right has dark hair and wears a black long-sleeved shirt with blue jeans. The right man speaks and gestures with his hands while the left man listens quietly. The background features purple furniture and eclectic wall art.

A woman with long wavy dark hair and a light blue-and-white zip jacket sits beside a man with short brown hair wearing a dark blue button-down. The woman speaks and gestures with her hands while the man listens with his arms crossed. They are seated against a digital backdrop of a misty city skyline featuring the Thunderbolts logo and a large skyscraper silhouette.

A split-screen podcast features a man in a grey trucker hat and white graphic T-shirt talking to a woman with long dark hair wearing a beige jacket. Both sit behind professional microphones in a studio with wood-paneled walls and posters. The man speaks and smiles while the woman listens attentively and grins. All elements remain static within their respective frames during the conversation.

Two women engage in a split-screen video call. The individual on the left has dark tied-back hair, a purple t-shirt, and wired earbuds, speaking actively to the camera. The individual on the right features long straight black hair and a light-colored top, listening calmly with a slight smile. Settings include a grey sofa and neutral curtains on the left, while the right side displays a modern floor lamp and framed wall art.

A man with a buzz cut wearing a maroon velvet jacket and embroidered vest speaks into a branded microphone. Beside him, a woman with a black bob and bangs wears an off-the-shoulder white dress. The man talks while the woman stands still, facing forward. They are positioned in front of a white press backdrop filled with ENT.QQ.COM and V.QQ.COM logos and circular icons.

Two young men with styled dark hair sit on a beige sofa against a backdrop of neutral curtains. The man on the left wears a tan plaid jacket with a crest, while the man on the right wears a matching jacket with a dark brown sweater draped over his shoulders. The man on the right holds a small white sign labeled WINK. They transition from neutral expressions to gentle smiles while glancing toward the camera and each other.

A man with dark hair in a grey coat and a woman in a beige blazer sit together against a white wall featuring a potted cactus and framed art. The man speaks while looking at the woman, who turns her head to face him. An orange exclamation mark graphic appears near her head at the end.

An older woman with blonde wavy hair wears a navy embroidered blazer, while a younger redhead wears a maroon knit top. The older woman speaks and gestures with her right hand near her face. The younger woman smiles and looks at her companion. They are positioned against a backdrop of tan vertical pleated curtains.

A man with wavy black hair in a white shirt, black tie, and blue-and-black jacket sits beside a woman with shoulder-length brown hair wearing a brown off-the-shoulder dress. Both face the camera, maintaining subtle smiles and slight head tilts as they speak. The setting is an indoor studio featuring a background of glowing monitors displaying various colorful logos and graphics.

A woman with a dark braid in a blue and grey top and a man in a black shirt sit on a blue couch. The man holds a red sign with white text. They speak toward the camera, and the man waves his hand. The setting is a minimalist indoor space with a white wall.

Two men sit in a studio against a cosmic, starry background. On the left, a heavy-set man with short dark hair wears a gray suit and striped tie, sitting still with a smile. On the right, a slender man with a signature red quiff wears a dark suit and red tie. He holds a blue card and speaks to the camera, ending with a wide-mouthed expression. The scene is static except for the speaker's facial movements.

Two men sit in director's chairs against a plain white studio background. The man on the left has a muscular build, dark hair, and wears a grey sleeveless knit vest. The man on the right has curly brown hair and wears a beige button-down shirt. Both hold white cards labeled quinn. During the clip, the curly-haired man speaks and gestures with his right hand while the other man looks on. The setting is minimalist and brightly lit.

Two fair-skinned young men with styled black hair sit on a beige sofa against neutral curtains. Both wear tan checkered jackets with crests; the man on the right has a brown sweater over his shoulders. As a WINK sign appears, the man on the right speaks and gestures with his hands while the man on the left listens and looks toward the camera.

A woman in a white draped blouse and hair bun stands beside a man in a black jacket. The man speaks into a TikTok-branded microphone with slight hand gestures while the woman listens quietly. They are positioned against a dark green textured backdrop featuring television logos in the corners.

A young man with short brown hair wears a black graphic t-shirt and silver chain, sitting beside a woman with long blonde hair in a black turtleneck. The man talks and nods while the woman watches him and smiles. They sit in a studio featuring beige curtains, a city window view, and a movie title overlay.

A split-screen shows a man in a white cap and t-shirt on the left and a woman with long dark hair in a white t-shirt on the right. Both wear microphones in a wood-paneled studio. The man smiles and listens while the woman talks, gesturing and pointing with her hand. The background features a basketball poster on the left and vintage license plates on the right.

A woman with straight black hair in a red top interviews another with an elaborate curly updo wearing a white shawl. The interviewee speaks and smiles into a silver handheld microphone. They stand before floral wallpaper with a blue electric fan visible in the background.

A woman with shoulder-length brown hair in a red short-sleeved dress sits beside a man with short dark hair wearing a white t-shirt and black blazer. They sit in white armchairs against a background of sheer curtains and patterned wall art. The woman remains still, looking toward the man, while he gestures with his hands and speaks, looking directly forward.

Two men sit side-by-side indoors. On the left, a man with glasses and brown hair wears a blue button-down shirt with floral patterns. On the right, a man with short dark hair wears a brown track jacket. They speak toward the camera with subtle hand gestures and head movements. The background is a plain wall with framed pictures hanging above them.

Bill Hader, wearing a brown sweater and jeans, sits in a patterned armchair facing Conan O’Brien. Conan, in a dark suit and tie, gestures with both hands while speaking from behind a wooden desk. The setting is a late-night talk show with a New York City skyline backdrop at night under blue curtains.

Two men sit on a mustard couch within a colorful, themed studio. On the left, a bald man in a grey blazer and graphic tee looks downward silently. To his right, a man with short dark hair wearing a black button-down shirt speaks while gesturing emphatically before clasping his hands. The background features ornate pillars and vibrant decor typical of a television talk show set.

A man in a black tuxedo and bowtie stands beside a woman in a light blue sleeveless gown. The man has dark hair and a slim build, while the woman has long brown hair. They initially face forward before turning to exchange glances and smiles. The background features a 2016 MBC Drama Awards sign and a digital screen within a dimly lit indoor venue.

Two women sit behind gold Emmy awards in a studio. The woman on the left has short blonde hair, wears a black high-necked dress, and laughs while holding a microphone. The woman on the right has long reddish-blonde hair, wears a silver and black sequined one-shoulder gown, and speaks while gesturing. They are positioned against a purple curtain backdrop accented by gold spherical decorations.

A man in a grey blazer and a female athlete in a navy-red jersey with a China flag stand on a stage. The man speaks into a microphone, gesturing with his hands. The athlete listens quietly, standing still. Behind them, a digital screen displays her name and ranking against a purple-lit sports arena background.

Two men converse in an indoor setting. On the left, an older man with thinning grey hair and a blue striped button-down shirt gestures with his hands while speaking. To the right, a younger man with dark hair and a goatee sits holding a tablet, listening attentively. They are positioned on either side of a small table holding a yellow floral arrangement in a black vase and several books. The background features a window with white sheer curtains and a wooden grid frame.

Two men stand before a promotional backdrop. The man on the left has short dark hair and wears a white scarf with a black blazer. The man on the right, with styled black hair, wears a white shirt and black jacket. He speaks into a branded microphone and gestures with his hands. The setting is a stage featuring a large SING logo background with warm lighting.

Two men sit facing each other on chairs against a dark blue studio backdrop. The man on the left has short dark hair, wearing a grey t-shirt with black trim and dark pants, sitting calmly with a smile. The man on the right wears glasses and a black long-sleeved shirt; he gestures with his arm, laughs, and leans forward. The environment is a minimalist stage with simple seating and dark lighting.

An East Asian woman in a black blazer and white top speaks into a microphone while seated beside a baby in a beige shirt. The woman has shoulder-length dark hair and looks between the microphone and the camera. The baby remains still, looking forward. They are positioned in an indoor classroom featuring desks and a window with a blurred urban view.

A woman with short blonde hair and a slim build wears a blue sleeveless dress with silver stud accents and a small cutout. She sits in a black chair, speaking and gesturing with her left hand before using her right hand to count on her fingers. Facing her, a woman with a brown bob in a black dress holds a white script. They are positioned on a stage with a dark background and a large, diagonal purple panel displaying a Women in the World logo. The setting is a professional interview with clear, focused lighting.

A young woman with long black hair in a white shirt and a young man with brown hair in a white polo sit side-by-side. They wave their hands and smile toward the camera while speaking. The setting is an indoor space featuring a blurred green cloth with strawberry patterns in the background.

A man with dark wavy hair in a dark blazer and a woman with wavy brown hair in a light blue V-neck dress sit for an interview. They speak and gesture while seated in front of a Me Before You movie poster. The man talks actively as the woman reacts with facial expressions. The setting is a brightly lit indoor promotional event.

A woman with long black hair in a white shirt and a man with short brown hair in a white sweater sit side-by-side. They smile and wave at the camera while speaking. Behind them is a green patterned blanket with strawberry and sun graphics. The setting is a brightly lit indoor space.

Two men with short dark hair sit on a dark couch. The man on the left wears a white t-shirt and holds papers, while the man on the right wears a black graphic t-shirt and holds a small branded sign. The man on the right speaks while the other listens. They are positioned against a tiled wall featuring green botanical leaf patterns, with a stylized black cat ornament on a side table to the right. A logo is visible in the upper right corner.

Two men sit in a dark indoor setting. The man in the foreground has a buzz cut, round wire-rim glasses, and a tan t-shirt, speaking and gesturing toward the camera. Behind him, another man with black hair and glasses laughs heartily. Vertical Chinese text is visible on the right side of the frame.

Two stout men perform on a stage wearing dark traditional Chinese changshans. The man on the left has a buzz cut and speaks expressively, gesturing with his hands and pointing his thumb upward. The man on the right has wavy dark hair and listens while standing still. They are positioned behind a table covered in red cloth, set against a solid red background with microphones and logos visible.

A young woman with long black hair in a white shirt and a man with short brown hair in a white sweater sit side-by-side. Both smile and gesture with their hands while speaking directly to the camera. They are positioned against a green patterned textile in a brightly lit indoor space.

Two Asian men with short dark hair sit on a dark sofa. The man on the left wears a plain white t-shirt and holds a stack of papers, while the man on the right wears a black t-shirt with a graphic logo and holds a microphone. The man in white looks at his papers and speaks, and the man in black listens and responds. They are positioned in front of a wall featuring a green tropical leaf pattern. To their right sits a large, black cat-shaped decorative lamp on a side table. A logo for ONE IS ALL is visible in the upper right corner.

A man and a woman stand against a plain white wall. The man wears a white turtleneck under a grey speckled cardigan, looking towards the woman. She has long dark hair, silver hoop earrings, and a ruffled cream blouse. She speaks with subtle facial movements while the man remains stationary and attentive. The setting is a minimalist indoor space with flat lighting.

Two young males are in an indoor room. The individual in the foreground has short dark hair and wears a pink shirt, looking forward with his hand near his mouth. Behind him, a boy with glasses and a blue California t-shirt lifts his shirt to expose his stomach. The background includes a red bookshelf, white walls, and a black storage chest with text.

Three men sit on a white tufted sofa against a blue wall featuring a circular neon light. The man on the left wears a black patterned button-down and gestures while speaking. The middle man has short blonde hair and wears a striped maroon and grey sweater, looking forward. The man on the right wears a grey textured sweater and smiles. They remain seated throughout the clip with minor head and hand movements. A London Theatre logo is visible in the bottom right corner.

Two slender young women stand in a neutral hallway with off-white walls and dark doors. Both have dark hair styled in high pigtails tied with red and blue plaid ribbons. The individual on the left wears a white graphic t-shirt, while the woman on the right wears a blue and black tracksuit jacket. They stand with arms crossed, facing the camera and engaging in a brief conversation involving subtle facial expressions and head movements.

A woman with wavy brown hair in a tan coat leans her head against a man with salt-and-pepper hair and a goatee wearing a grey sweater vest. They both tilt their heads together, smiling and laughing joyfully while looking upward. Their expressions convey deep contentment and happiness against a solid, dark red stage background. The static close-up shot captures their facial movements and upper torsos in a theatrical setting.

A woman with long brown hair in a tan athletic jacket holds a microphone for a man with short black hair. He wears a light blue sequined shirt and holds a blue product box while speaking and gesturing with his hand. A third person is partially visible on the left. The scene takes place in a plain white indoor room.

A woman in a red long-sleeved dress and gold necklace laughs while being interviewed. Beside her, a man in a black suit and tie stands still with a neutral expression. An interviewer’s hand holds a white microphone toward them. The setting is an outdoor building entrance featuring glass doors and dark architectural frames.

An older man in a grey blazer speaks into a microphone, gesturing with his hands toward a younger athlete. The athlete, wearing a black Chinese national team jersey and a blue headband, stands with his hands on his hips and listens. They are positioned on a stage in front of a large digital screen displaying ITTF World Cup branding and trophy graphics in a dark arena setting.

Two men sit in wooden chairs against a blue curtain backdrop. On the left, a man wears a checkered flat cap, brown blazer, and blue shirt, smiling and reacting. To his right, a man with dark curly hair, a black blazer, and a white t-shirt speaks while gesturing with his hands. Both have slim builds and maintain relaxed postures during the interaction.

Two men with short black hair and lean builds pose side-by-side. The man on the left wears a black leather jacket over a white t-shirt, while the man on the right wears a navy blazer over a light blue button-down. Both smile at the camera, alternating between waving their hands and offering thumbs-up gestures. They are positioned in front of a gray wall featuring a large, pink neon light installation shaped like concentric rounded rectangles.

Two men with styled black hair wear matching brown plaid crest blazers; the man on the right has a brown sweater over his shoulders and holds a WINK sign. They sit on a cream sofa against light curtains, talking and looking at each other while gesturing subtly.

Two young women with long black hair sit together. The woman on the left has straight bangs and wears a black cardigan over a teal-striped top. The woman on the right has a side-swept ponytail and wears a black cardigan over a red-striped shirt. They talk and shift slightly while looking off-camera. The setting is an indoor studio with a white background featuring blue and green Tencent QQ logos.

Two young girls stand against a solid lime green background. The girl on the left features blonde braided pigtails and a dark green dress with a white collar, while the girl on the right has long red hair and wears a floral dress over a white shirt. Both hold teal cue cards and speak toward the camera, maintaining cheerful expressions with subtle head tilts.

A woman with long dark hair and a white top leans against a man with short dark hair wearing a black shirt and silver necklace. They pose closely for the camera, maintaining subtle smiles and direct eye contact. The setting is a dimly lit indoor space at night with a window showing distant city lights in the background.

Two actors wear motion capture suits and facial head rigs in a professional studio. The man has short brown hair and wears a blue suit; the woman has dark hair in a grey and red suit. In the central wide shot, the woman walks toward the man standing near a table. The outer panels provide synchronized close-ups of their facial expressions and speech. The environment is a grey motion capture stage with studio lighting and minimal furniture.

Two stout men in traditional Chinese tunics stand before microphones against green curtains. The man on the left, wearing a maroon tunic with dark hair, speaks and gestures with his right hand. The bald man on the right wears a dark brown tunic and watches his partner. A large bouquet of pink and white flowers sits between them, with a red floral wreath visible on the far right.

Two Asian men in dark suits and ties stand on a stage before a vintage microphone. The man on the left, featuring dark hair and a tie clip, gestures with a clenched fist while speaking. The man on the right stands still, watching him. The background includes decorative red lights, traditional lanterns, and white curtains in a studio setting.

A split-screen video features two men in separate indoor settings. On the left, a young Asian man with wavy dark hair and a black sweatshirt plays an acoustic guitar and sings toward the camera. On the right, an older Asian man in a light-colored button-up and khaki trousers sits on a patterned cream sofa, holding a mug and petting a small dog. The left background is a plain neutral wall, while the right depicts a furnished living room with a lamp and framed wall art. Both men remain seated throughout the clip.

A heavy-set man with messy blonde hair wears a white Bilibili Gaming jersey while speaking during an interview. Beside him, a woman with dark hair and a black face mask in a floral blouse looks upward at him. They stand before a black backdrop featuring a large red circular logo and MSI 2023 event text. The man speaks with subtle facial movements while looking slightly off-camera.

Two young women sit behind a white microphone in a bright room. The woman on the left has long dark hair and wears a striped top, while the woman on the right has blonde hair and wears a red camisole with earphones. During the clip, the blonde woman uses a colorful makeup brush to gently stroke the microphone's mesh head. The dark-haired woman watches the brush movements intently. The background consists of light-colored walls, a mirror, and neutral curtains.

Two men with styled dark hair wear black suits on a brightly lit stage; one blazer features patterned lapels. They hold microphones, speaking and gesturing actively while smiling. The background consists of a television studio set with blue neon lights and large graphic characters.

A young man with short brown hair in a striped t-shirt and a woman with a brown bob in a green graphic tee sit at a table. The man speaks while looking off-camera, then glances down. The woman holds chopsticks, listening with a subtle smile before looking at her bowl. They are in a well-lit indoor dining area with wooden furniture and noodle bowls.

A man in a black suit with gold buttons and a woman in a pink jacket stand onstage. The man has styled dark hair and holds a red microphone, while the woman wears a bun and red lipstick. He speaks into the microphone as she smiles and looks toward him and the audience. Behind them, a crowd of children in colorful traditional costumes and butterfly hairpieces stands against a bright pink and purple backdrop.

Two Asian men wearing glasses sit in a cluttered indoor space. The man on the left, in a black tank top, gestures animatedly with his hands and laughs. The man on the right wears a maroon t-shirt and listens while resting his chin on his hand. The background is a dense room filled with bookshelves, a computer monitor, hanging clothes, and multiple backpacks and tote bags.

A fair-skinned woman with long black hair wearing a white collared shirt and gold jewelry sits beside a man with short brown hair in a white sweater. They both smile and wave toward the camera. The indoor setting features a green patterned blanket with red fruit graphics behind them.

Two actors sit side-by-side against a promotional backdrop. The man on the left has wavy dark brown hair and wears a dark blazer over a black shirt. The woman on the right has shoulder-length wavy hair and wears a light blue dress with pink lapels. They both talk and gesture with their hands throughout the interview. The background consists of a large poster for the movie Me Before You.

A woman and man sit side-by-side facing the camera against a blurred green patterned backdrop. The woman has long straight black hair, wearing a white button-down and gold necklace. The man has short brown hair and wears a white sweater with a lapel mic. They smile and speak while the woman waves her hand toward the lens.

Two men with short black hair sit on a grey sofa. The man on the left wears a white t-shirt and holds papers, while the man on the right wears a black graphic t-shirt and holds a square logo card. They engage in a conversation, glancing at each other and the notes. The background features a tiled wall with green leaf patterns and a black cat-shaped lamp on a side table.

Two men sit in a dimly lit room. The foreground man has a buzzed head and round glasses, wearing a brown shirt while speaking and gesturing. Behind him, a man in a black shirt laughs. Vertical Chinese text appears on the right edge against the dark indoor background.

Two men in dark traditional Chinese changshan robes stand on a stage. The man on the left has a buzzed haircut and stout build, while the man on the right has dark hair and a larger frame. They perform a crosstalk routine; the man on the left speaks with active hand gestures, and the man on the right listens, occasionally interjecting. The background consists of a plain red backdrop, with microphones positioned in front of each performer.

A woman with long dark hair in a white shirt and a man with reddish-brown hair in a white sweater sit side-by-side. They face forward, smiling and talking directly to the camera. The woman waves slightly while the man gestures during speech. Behind them hangs a green fabric backdrop featuring stylized fruit and flower patterns.

Two men with short black hair sit on a dark couch. The man on the left wears a pale t-shirt and blue pants, holding white papers. The man on the right wears a black graphic t-shirt and blue jeans, holding a branded microphone. The man on the left glances between the papers and his companion while the man on the right speaks toward the camera. They are positioned against a wall with green leaf patterns. A black cat-shaped lamp sits on a small table to the right, and a logo is visible in the upper right corner.

A man in a white turtleneck and grey cardigan stands beside a woman in a ruffled beige blouse. Both have dark hair and lean builds. The woman speaks while the man watches her. They are positioned against a plain, light-colored wall.

Two young males are in an indoor room. In the foreground, a boy with short black hair and a pink polo shirt looks toward the camera. Standing behind him, a thinner boy wearing glasses and a blue t-shirt with California 1849 text lifts his shirt to reveal his midriff. The setting features a white wall, a red bookshelf with books, and black storage drawers labeled with white text.

Three men sit on a white tufted sofa. The man on the left wears a black button-down shirt and talks with active hand gestures. The man in the middle has short blonde hair and wears a striped sweater. The man on the right wears a grey sweater and smiles. They are positioned against a blue wall with a circular neon light fixture. A logo is visible in the lower right corner.

A woman with wavy brown hair wearing a shaggy brown coat sits next to a bearded man in a navy blazer and white shirt. They are seated in blue chairs against a purple backdrop featuring Cannes 2023 logos. Both figures look toward the camera; the man moves his hand to his face while the woman remains still.

A man with a buzzed haircut and athletic build wears a maroon velvet jacket over an embroidered vest, holding a microphone. Beside him stands a woman with a black bob and bangs in an off-the-shoulder white dress. The man speaks into the microphone while the woman remains still. They are positioned in front of a white media wall featuring ENT.QQ.COM and Tencent video logos.

A middle-aged woman with wavy brown hair in a tan coat and an older man with grey hair and a goatee wearing a beige vest lean their heads together. They smile broadly and laugh with shared affection. The scene is set against a dark, indistinct background, focusing on their warm expressions and close physical proximity.

In a white room, two people stand side-by-side. On the left, a woman with long wavy brown hair wears a brown and white track jacket, holding a microphone while smiling. To her right, a person with short dark hair and a slim build wears a light blue shimmering jacket over a white shirt. This individual holds a blue gift box, gesturing and speaking animatedly toward the camera. The background is a plain, minimalist indoor space.

A woman with an updo wears a red long-sleeved dress and gold necklace, standing beside a man in a black suit and tie. The woman laughs and speaks during an interview while the man maintains a stoic expression. A reporter holds a microphone toward them in front of a glass building entrance.

An older man in a light grey blazer and black shirt speaks into a microphone, gesturing with his free hand. Beside him stands a young athlete wearing a dark patterned jersey with a Chinese flag and a blue headband, holding his hands on his hips. The scene is set against a large screen displaying ITTF Men's World Cup Macao 2024 branding and dynamic player graphics in a professional arena.

Two men sit in wooden director chairs against a pleated blue curtain backdrop. The man on the left wears a brown patterned flat cap, tan blazer, and blue button-down shirt, looking downward with a smile. Beside him, a man with dark curly hair in a black blazer and white t-shirt smiles, speaks, and gestures with his hands. Both individuals maintain a seated, relaxed posture in a brightly lit panel setting.
